character: Photorealistic character reference sheet of one man, Arjun, shown four times in a row: front view, three-quarter view facing left, left side profile, and back of the head. Arjun is a 28-year-old Nepali man with medium-brown skin with warm undertones, an oval face with a clean, defined jawline, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thick straight black eyebrows, a straight nose, medium-full lips, small ears that sit close to the head, and a slim athletic build. Calm, confident expression, mouth closed. Natural black hair in a classic taper cut, about 4 cm on top, combed to the side. Light even stubble. Plain black crew-neck T-shirt. Soft, even studio light. Plain, flat warm sand background (#D8CDBF). No text.
older: The same man, Arjun, at about 50: identical face shape, eyes, nose, ears and skin tone, with light lines at the eyes and slightly fuller cheeks. Natural black hair with salt-and-pepper grey at the temples and through the top. Same four views, clothing, light and background as the main reference sheet. No text.
fixed:
Photorealistic studio image for a barbershop style guide. Square 1:1, at least 1536 x 1536 px.
CHARACTER (identical in every image): Arjun, a 28-year-old Nepali man with medium-brown skin with warm undertones, an oval face with a clean, defined jawline, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thick straight black eyebrows, a straight nose, medium-full lips, small ears close to the head, slim athletic build. Calm, confident expression, mouth closed. Plain black crew-neck T-shirt. No glasses, jewellery, tattoos, piercings or hats. Natural black hair unless the item says otherwise. Match the attached character reference exactly.
LIGHT: soft, diffused key light from the front left, gentle fill from the right, subtle rim light separating the hair from the background. True-to-life skin tones and natural skin texture. Sharp focus on hair and beard detail, 85 mm portrait lens look.
BACKGROUND: one flat, seamless studio backdrop in the solid colour named in BACKDROP, evenly lit like a painted colour-block wall. No gradient, texture, props or background shadows.
LAYOUT: the main view, head and shoulders, on the left, filling about 60% of the width. A second, smaller view in the lower right, slightly overlapping the main view, with a soft fade at its edge. Four or five callouts on the right: a thin charcoal line (#3A3A3A) runs from a small white dot with a thin grey outline, placed on the feature, to its label. Each label has a bold title in charcoal (#1E1E1E) and one line of description below it in mid grey (#6B6B6B), in a clean modern sans-serif, left-aligned, with generous spacing. Labels never cover the face.

categories.H: HAIR IMAGE RULES: the beard and moustache are the same in every hair image: light even stubble, 1-2 mm, with a clean curved neck line. Main view as the item says. Second view: back of the head, showing the back of the cut and the nape. Callouts point to the top, the sides, the blend or line, the back and the nape.
categories.B: BEARD IMAGE RULES: the haircut is the same in every beard image unless the item says otherwise: a classic taper cut, short tapered sides, about 4 cm on top combed neatly to the side, natural black. Main view: three-quarter front facing left, showing the cheek line and chin. Second view: left side profile from chin to ear, showing the jaw and neck line. Callouts point to the cheek line, sideburn, chin, moustache and neck line.
categories.M: MOUSTACHE IMAGE RULES: the haircut is the same classic taper cut as in beard images. Cheeks, chin and neck are clean-shaven unless the moustache itself runs down to the jaw. Main view: straight front, head and shoulders. Second view: close-up of the mouth area at a three-quarter angle. Callouts point to the lip line, the ends, the shape and any shaved areas.
categories.C: COLOUR IMAGE RULES: the haircut is the same in every colour image: a classic side part, about 6 cm on top combed to the side, tapered sides, so the colour shows across the top. Face clean-shaven. Backdrop always Sand (#D8CDBF), so the shade reads true. Main view: three-quarter front facing left, in soft daylight-balanced light so the true tone shows. Second view: close-up of the top of the head in brighter light, showing the shine and the roots. Add a small round colour swatch in the top right corner with the shade name and level below it. Callouts point to the shade, grey coverage, shine and hairline.
categories.L: READY LOOK IMAGE RULES: show every part listed in the item, and nothing else changes. Main view: three-quarter front facing left. Second view: left side profile. One callout for each part (hair, beard, moustache, colour), plus one finishing note.

avoid: AVOID: any text other than the callout labels, misspelled words, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra people, hands in frame, hats, glasses, jewellery, tattoos, props, gradient, busy or textured backgrounds, harsh shadows, distorted or extra ears, mismatched eyes, a different face from the reference, blurry or smudged hair edges, cartoon or illustration style, 3D render look, plastic skin, oversharpening.
cleanSuffix: No callouts, lines, dots or text.
